# Processing Functions
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

rm_smallsample_functions <- function(df) {
  # Return the sub_df if sub_df has more than 1000 rows, otherwise NULL
  if (nrow(df) > 40000) {
    return(df)
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
  return(df)
}

removezeros_countrows <- function(df) {
  df = df[df$duration != 0, ]
  df$rows <- nrow(df)
  return(df)
}

calculate_percentiles <- function(df) {
  p50    <- quantile(df$duration, probs = 0.50)
  p95    <- quantile(df$duration, probs = 0.95)
  p99    <- quantile(df$duration, probs = 0.99)
  p999    <- quantile(df$duration, probs = 0.999)
  p9999    <- quantile(df$duration, probs = 0.9999)
  p100   <- quantile(df$duration, probs = 1)

  df$start_timestamp = df$end_timestamp - df$duration
  df$p50   <- p50
  df$p95   <- p95
  df$p99   <- p99
  df$p999  <- p999
  df$p9999 <- p9999
  df$p100  <- p100

  return(df)
}

preprocess_data <- function(df) {
  # Split the df dataframe by values in func and apply filter_functions to each sub-dataframe
  inv2021_split <- lapply(split(df, df$func), rm_smallsample_functions)
  # Remove null entries in inv2021_split
  inv2021_split_nonull <- inv2021_split[!sapply(inv2021_split, is.null)]
  inv2021_split_nozeros <- lapply(inv2021_split_nonull, removezeros_countrows)
  inv2021_split_processed <- lapply(inv2021_split_nozeros, calculate_percentiles)
  
  # Merge data
  inv2021_merged = do.call(rbind, inv2021_split_processed)
  inv2021_merged = data.frame(
    app = inv2021_merged$app,
    func = inv2021_merged$func,
    rows = inv2021_merged$rows,
    start_timestamp = inv2021_merged$start_timestamp,
    duration = inv2021_merged$duration,
    end_timestamp = inv2021_merged$end_timestamp,
  
    p50 = inv2021_merged$p50,
    p95 = inv2021_merged$p95,
    p99 = inv2021_merged$p99,
    p999 = inv2021_merged$p999,
    p9999 = inv2021_merged$p9999,
    p100 = inv2021_merged$p100
  )
  
  # sort by start_timestamp
  inv2021_merged = select(
    inv2021_merged[order(inv2021_merged$start_timestamp),], 
    app, func, rows,
    start_timestamp, duration, end_timestamp,
    p50, p95, p99, p999, p9999, p100
  )
  return(inv2021_merged)
}
```

```{r echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load Azure Functions
```

# Plot Functions
```{r echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
plot_hist <- function(
    function_trace,
    function_preprocessed_trace,
    title,
    colors
) {
  # Calcula p50, p95, p99 e p100 automaticamente
  p50_original = quantile(function_trace, probs = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE)
  p50_preprocessed = quantile(function_preprocessed_trace, probs = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE)
  p95_original = quantile(function_trace, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
  p95_preprocessed  = quantile(function_preprocessed_trace, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
  p999_original = quantile(function_trace, probs = 0.999, na.rm = TRUE)
  p999_preprocessed  = quantile(function_preprocessed_trace, probs = 0.999, na.rm = TRUE)
  p100_original = quantile(function_trace, probs = 1.0, na.rm = TRUE)  # Maximum value
  p100_preprocessed  = quantile(function_preprocessed_trace, probs = 1.0, na.rm = TRUE)  # Maximum value
  
  # Prepare data with 4 different traces
  data_combined <- data.frame(
    duration = c(function_trace, 
                 function_trace[function_trace <= p95_original], 
                 function_preprocessed_trace,
                 function_preprocessed_trace[function_preprocessed_trace <= p95_preprocessed]),
    type = factor(c(rep("Original trace", length(function_trace)),
                    rep("Original truncated at p95", length(function_trace[function_trace <= p95_original])),
                    rep("preprocessed trace", length(function_preprocessed_trace)),
                    rep("preprocessed truncated at p95", length(function_preprocessed_trace[function_preprocessed_trace <= p95_preprocessed]))),
                  levels = c("Original trace", "Original truncated at p95", 
                            "preprocessed trace", "preprocessed truncated at p95"))
  )

  max_y <- data_combined %>% group_by(type) %>% summarise(ymax = max(hist(duration, breaks = 30, plot = FALSE)$counts))

    # Create color mapping for facets
  colors_mapping <- c("Original trace" = colors[1],           # Light red
                      "Original truncated at p95" = colors[3], # Dark red
                      "preprocessed trace" = colors[2],             # Light teal
                      "preprocessed truncated at p95" = colors[4])  # Dark teal
  
  # Create the plot
  ggplot(data_combined, aes(x = duration, fill = type)) +
    geom_histogram(alpha = 0.8, bins = 30) +
    facet_wrap(~type, scales = "free", nrow = 2, ncol = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_mapping) +

    
    # Add p50 lines only for truncated traces
    geom_vline(data = data.frame(type = "Original truncated at p95", p50 = p50_original), 
               aes(xintercept = p50), color = colors[5], linetype = "solid", size = 1.2) +
    geom_vline(data = data.frame(type = "preprocessed truncated at p95", p50 = p50_preprocessed), 
               aes(xintercept = p50), color = colors[6], linetype = "solid", size = 1.2) +
    
    # Add p999 lines only for non-truncated traces
    geom_vline(data = data.frame(type = "Original trace", p999 = p999_original), 
               aes(xintercept = p999), color = colors[5], linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
    geom_vline(data = data.frame(type = "preprocessed trace", p999 = p999_preprocessed), 
               aes(xintercept = p999), color = colors[6], linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
    # Add p100 (max) lines only for non-truncated traces
    geom_vline(data = data.frame(type = "Original trace", p100 = p100_original), 
               aes(xintercept = p100), color = colors[5], linetype = "dotted", size = 1.2) +
    geom_vline(data = data.frame(type = "preprocessed trace", p100 = p100_preprocessed), 
               aes(xintercept = p100), color = colors[6], linetype = "dotted", size = 1.2) +

    # Add text labels for the lines (vertical orientation)
    geom_text(data = data.frame(type = "Original truncated at p95", p50 = p50_original, y_pos = 0), 
              aes(x = p50, y = y_pos, label = "P50"), 
              color = colors[5], vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1, size = 3, fontface = "bold", angle = 90) +
    geom_text(data = data.frame(type = "Original trace", p999 = p999_original, y_pos = 0), 
              aes(x = p999, y = y_pos, label = "P999"), 
              color = colors[5], vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1, size = 3, fontface = "bold", angle = 90) +
    geom_text(data = data.frame(type = "Original trace", p100 = p100_original, y_pos = max_y$ymax[max_y$type == "Original trace"]/2), 
              aes(x = p100, y = y_pos, label = "P100"), 
              color = colors[5], vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1, size = 3, fontface = "bold", angle = 90) +
  
    geom_text(data = data.frame(type = "preprocessed truncated at p95", p50 = p50_preprocessed, y_pos = 0), 
              aes(x = p50, y = y_pos, label = "P50"), 
              color = colors[6], vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1, size = 3, fontface = "bold", angle = 90) +
    geom_text(data = data.frame(type = "preprocessed trace", p999 = p999_preprocessed, y_pos = 0), 
              aes(x = p999, y = y_pos, label = "P999"), 
              color = colors[6], vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1, size = 3, fontface = "bold", angle = 90) +
    geom_text(data = data.frame(type = "preprocessed trace", p100 = p100_preprocessed, y_pos = max_y$ymax[max_y$type == "preprocessed trace"]/2), 
              aes(x = p100, y = y_pos, label = "P100"), 
              color = colors[6], vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1, size = 3, fontface = "bold", angle = 90) +

    labs(title = paste("Histograms of Latencies for ", title),
         x = "Duration",
         y = "Frequency",
         caption = "Solid lines: P50 (Median values) | Dashed lines: P999 | Dotted lines: P100 (Maximum values)") +

    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",  # Remove legend since facet titles show the info
          strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5))
}

compare_traces <- function(
    df,
    df_preprocessed,
    func_ref,
    title,
    colors
) {
  function_trace       = subset(df,        func == func_ref)$duration
  function_preprocessed = subset(df_preprocessed, func == func_ref)$duration
  
  plot_hist(function_trace, function_preprocessed, title, colors)
}
```
